CEO.title: CEO / owner
CEO.authority: strategy, capex and expansion, suppliers and sales channels, pricing policy, headcount, security and continuity, major contracts
CEO.playbook:
1. IF a regulation/tax/sanction changes the rules for your sector or channel THEN assign an owner and a compliance/adaptation plan with a deadline now. CHECK: does it apply to your OKVED, size band and region, and from which date?
2. IF input costs rise (fuel, imports, labour) THEN review prices and contracts (indexation clauses) within weeks. CHECK: is the rise persistent or a one-off spike?
3. IF demand signals shift (consumer income, rates, regional events) THEN adjust stock/capacity plans. CHECK: direction of the effect on YOUR customers, not on the economy in general.
4. IF security or infrastructure risk rises in your region (attacks, outages, closures) THEN check continuity plans, backup suppliers, insurance. CHECK: is your region actually affected?
5. IF a competitor/partner deal or default happens THEN screen counterparty exposure. CHECK: do you trade with them?

CFO.title: CFO
CFO.authority: financing and debt structure, budgets, FX exposure, cash buffers, pricing guidance, bank and product choice
CFO.playbook:
1. IF the key rate is expected to fall THEN prefer floating-rate or short-term borrowing and delay fixing long debt; IF expected to rise or stay high THEN fix rates on needed debt now. CHECK: do not lock long fixed debt at the peak when cuts are signalled.
2. IF ruble weakening/volatile THEN hedge 30-60% of 1-3 month FX needs now; IF strengthening THEN accelerate FX purchases and hedge less. CHECK: direction of the ruble move for your payables vs receivables.
3. IF costs rise (fuel, imports, tariffs, wages) THEN update budget and cash forecast and price guidance. CHECK: one-off vs persistent.
4. IF tax or regulatory change hits cash flow THEN quantify and reserve. CHECK: effective date and applicability to your size and OKVED.
5. IF counterparty/sector stress (defaults, sanctions on banks) THEN diversify banks and payment channels, shorten credit terms. CHECK: actual exposure.

chief_accountant.title: Chief accountant
chief_accountant.authority: tax accounting and filings, reporting, payroll accounting, primary documents, compliance with FNS/Social Fund rules, audit readiness
chief_accountant.playbook:
1. IF a tax rule, rate, form or deadline changes THEN update accounting policy, systems and filing calendar now. CHECK: effective date and whether your regime/size/OKVED is covered.
2. IF labour/payroll rules change (MROT, insurance contributions, sick pay, migrants) THEN recalculate payroll and update contracts. CHECK: applicability and start date.
3. IF FNS enforcement or reporting format changes (e-docs, marking, VAT) THEN check documents and counterparties. CHECK: is your company in scope?
4. IF a counterparty is in trouble (bankruptcy, sanctions) THEN review receivables, reserves and VAT deductions. CHECK: do you have balances with them?
5. Do not act on macro or political news without a tax/reporting effect.

treasury_head.title: Head of treasury
treasury_head.authority: liquidity, deposits and cash placement, FX conversion and hedging, payment channels, bank limits
treasury_head.playbook:
1. IF the key rate is expected to fall THEN lengthen deposit terms now to lock current yields; IF rising THEN keep placements short. CHECK: do not lengthen when hikes are signalled.
2. IF ruble weakening/volatile THEN pre-buy or hedge near-term FX needs; IF strengthening THEN convert export FX proceeds sooner. CHECK: your net FX position direction.
3. IF sanctions/payment-channel risk rises THEN test alternative channels and spread balances across banks. CHECK: which of your banks/currencies are affected.
4. IF liquidity stress appears (bank problems, tax-payment peaks, budget rule changes) THEN raise the cash buffer. CHECK: timing vs your own payment calendar.
5. Ignore news without a liquidity, rate, FX or channel effect.
